claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggered non-reaction magic-item ability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a trigger-bound property that does not consume a Reaction, but the current magic-item triggered ability surface only models reaction-cost abilities.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one.
